description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, broken down by country/region categories shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categories as years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Number of datasets,” displayed on a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at approximately \(10^0\), \(10^1\), and \(10^2\) (covering roughly 1 to 100+ datasets). For each year, multiple adjacent (grouped) vertical bars represent different categories: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown), with no stacking. Approximate bar heights by year are: 2012 shows USA at about 2; 2013 shows USA at about 2; 2014 shows Other about 2 and USA about 1; 2015 shows Other about 3 and DE about 1; 2016 shows Other about 4, USA about 7, IN about 3, and UK about 2; 2017 shows Other about 18, USA about 14, IN about 1, UK about 9, IT about 5, and DE about 1; 2018 shows Other about 30, USA about 12, IN about 4, UK about 4, IT about 4, and DE about 4; 2019 shows Other about 50, USA about 16, IN about 6, UK about 2, IT about 8, and DE about 1; 2020 shows Other about 85, USA about 40, IN about 12, UK about 15, IT about 2, and DE about 18; 2021 shows Other slightly above 100, USA about 45, IN about 20, UK about 17, IT about 12, and DE about 9; 2022 shows a set of lighter-tinted bars near the right with approximate values around Other ~25, USA ~3, IN ~9, UK ~8, and IT ~1 (DE is not clearly visible for 2022). The bars are not sorted by height within each year, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the legend and the lighter coloring used for the 2022 bars.
